翻阅生活碎片NOTES FROM LIFE

旅途里的片刻MOMENTS ALONG THE WAY

北海的海风、重庆的舞台灯光、北京的古建、青岛的帆船、三亚的朋友与椰林、万宁的日落、陵水的秋千、珠海的灯塔、广州的夜色、自贡的灯火、内江江边的日常，还有芒市的白塔与大理的湖面。
每一段旅程，都有自己的颜色。Beihai sea air, Chongqing stage lights, Beijing’s old roofs, Qingdao sailboats, friends and palms in Sanya, Wanning’s sunset, a swing in Lingshui, Zhuhai’s lighthouse, Guangzhou after dark, Zigong lanterns, ordinary moments by the river in Neijiang, pagodas in Mangshi, and the lake in Dali.
Every trip has its own colors.
